purpose: Convert CSD-036 health and readiness evidence into controlled production execution authority, admission decisions, ordering, concurrency limits, pause/resume behavior and escalation.
core_principle: No production job executes merely because it exists; execution is admitted only when its dependencies, health scope and master authority are valid.

readiness_policy.CONDITIONAL_READY: Only explicitly whitelisted jobs may be admitted.
readiness_policy.NOT_READY: No new dependent jobs may be admitted.
readiness_policy.PRODUCTION_LOCKED: Only jobs bound to the frozen authorization snapshot may execute.

execution_controls.ordering: Dependency-safe topological order with critical-path priority.
execution_controls.concurrency: Bound by provider capability, job dependencies and current health state.
execution_controls.deduplication: Identical job fingerprints are coalesced; duplicate execution is blocked.
execution_controls.backpressure: Admission slows or stops when provider queues, failure rates or health degrade.
execution_controls.fairness: No eligible job is starved indefinitely by repeated retries of another job.

health_response.DEGRADED: Reduce concurrency and admit only safe eligible work.
health_response.RECOVERING: Pause dependent work; allow recovery and explicitly safe jobs.

pause_resume.resume_policy: Resume only jobs whose admission fingerprints still match.

execution_ledger.immutability: Every admission, pause, resume, block and escalation decision is append-only.
